parameters.site_description: A reproducible media optimization pipeline that explains every transformation.

announcement.label: Reproducible media pipelines, now with reviewable provenance

hero.title: Transform large media into deliberate, verifiable outputs.
hero.description: OptiFlow plans each conversion, records its inputs, and produces compact artifacts without erasing the path back to the source.

demo.title: See what changed before accepting the output.
demo.description: Every run reports the selected strategy, source identity, output characteristics, and reproducibility evidence.

features.title: Make every media transformation reviewable.
features.description: Plan, apply, verify, and explain the work through one stable contract.

items.title: Preview transformations
items.description: Resolve inputs, codecs, targets, and expected changes before mutating media.

items.title: Apply deliberate profiles
items.description: Use versioned profiles instead of a growing pile of one-off shell commands.

items.title: Check the artifact
items.description: Confirm metadata, dimensions, streams, budgets, and output integrity.

items.title: Retain provenance
items.description: Record enough evidence to reproduce and audit every accepted transformation.

useCases.title: One contract across different media work.
useCases.description: Keep the workflow stable while profiles adapt to the artifact.

items.title: Web delivery
items.description: Prepare responsive assets against explicit weight and quality budgets.

items.title: Creative archives
items.description: Create practical derivatives without losing source identity or history.

items.title: Automated publishing
items.description: Give CI a deterministic command and machine-readable evidence.

code.title: Make the plan visible.
code.description: A small command surface keeps local and automated execution aligned.
code.value:
optiflow plan --input source.mov --profile web-video
optiflow apply --plan optiflow.plan.json
optiflow verify --artifact dist/source.mp4

architecture.title: Separate intent, transformation, and evidence.
architecture.description: Each stage has one responsibility and a reviewable handoff.

items.title: 1. Resolve
items.description: Combine source facts with a versioned optimization profile.

items.title: 2. Transform
items.description: Execute only the operations captured by the reviewed plan.

items.title: 3. Verify
items.description: Measure the output and write durable provenance for later inspection.

integrations.title: Compose with the tools already in the workflow.
integrations.description: OptiFlow remains useful locally and gains stronger guarantees when composed.

items.title: Relay
items.description: Run the same checks in reusable publication workflows.

items.title: Identity
items.description: Consume reviewed asset targets and brand metadata.

items.title: Observatory
items.description: Expose conformance evidence without making the renderer a collector.

trust.title: Inspect the contract, not a marketing score.
trust.description: Security, accessibility, and change evidence remain direct, durable links.

faq.title: Questions teams ask before trusting a media pipeline.
faq.description: Direct answers stay readable without a client-side accordion library.

items.question: Does OptiFlow replace the original media?
items.answer: No. Source ownership and retention remain explicit, and generated derivatives are recorded separately.

items.question: Can the same profile run in CI?
items.answer: Yes. The canonical commands and evidence model are designed to remain consistent across local and Relay execution.

items.question: Is a single quality score enough?
items.answer: No. Quality is evaluated through explicit artifact properties and bounded trade-offs, not one opaque metric.

finalCta.title: Start with a plan you can inspect.
finalCta.description: Install OptiFlow, resolve one media artifact, and review the proposed transformation before applying it.

footer.summary: Reproducible media optimization for inspectable creative systems.
